Exact computation cost for the {}^{210}\mathrm{Bi} \to {}^{210}\mathrm{Po} transfer-matrix product (Example 8, the heaviest nucleus in the verification table): the braid word has 209 generators and \binom{210}{2} = 21{,}945 transfer-matrix multiplications, with no approximation or truncation.

Quantity Value
Generators 209
Transfer matrix multiplications 21{,}945
Max polynomial degree \leq 44{,}099
Wall-clock time (modern hardware) < 1 ms
